action.command: command -v rule-engine-lint >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Rule Engine: rule-engine-lint is not on PATH, so the saved file was not linted. Install the rule-engine package (the power skill ships scripts/bootstrap.sh).' >&2; exit 0; }; ctx="$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)"; f="$(printf '%s' "$ctx" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin) if sys.stdin.isatty()==False else {}; f=d.get("filePath") or d.get("file_path") or d.get("path"); print(f if isinstance(f,str) else "")' 2>/dev/null || true)"; [ -n "$f" ] || f="$KIRO_FILE_PATH"; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; rule-engine-lint --file "$f" --fail-on error,critical
